keys: Alice cierra la puerta de su edificio.
en: Alice closes the door of her building.

keys: El aire de la mañana le golpea la cara. Hace frío.
en: The morning air hits her face. It's cold.

keys: Camina rápido. No quiere cruzarse con nadie.
en: She walks fast. She doesn't want to run into anyone.

keys: Las escaleras del metro aparecen al final de la calle.
en: The metro stairs appear at the end of the street.

keys: Lee de pie, en pleno andén.
en: Reading standing up, right on the platform.

keys: Yo me mareo si leo en el metro.
en: I get dizzy if I read on the metro.

keys: Habla por teléfono como si nadie la oyera.
en: She talks on the phone like nobody can hear her.

keys: Auriculares puestos. Así nadie te habla.
en: Headphones on. That way nobody talks to you.
I have mine on too.
Almost there, Alice...
It's cold in here...

keys: Sigue con su periódico. Ni levantó la vista.
en: Still reading his newspaper. He didn't even look up.

keys: El chico de los auriculares. Subimos en la misma estación.
en: The guy with the headphones. We got on at the same station.
He hasn't even seen me. Good.

keys: Mira por la ventana como si fuera la primera vez.
en: He looks out the window like it's the first time.

keys: ...O como si no quisiera mirar a nadie.
en: ...Or like he doesn't want to look at anyone.

keys: Ya está... Alice, solo tienes que quedarte aquí.
en: That's it... Alice, you just have to stay here.
I feel tired...

keys: Ya estoy dentro... Ahora no puedo echarme atrás.
en: I'm on board... I can't back out now.

keys: Me tiemblan las piernas. Mejor me siento.
en: My legs are shaking. I'd better sit down.

keys: El mismo mapa. Nada me suena.
en: The same map. Nothing looks familiar.

keys: Otra máquina. No, es para Wilson.
en: Another machine. No, it's for Wilson.
I already have a ticket.
Closed.
Staff only.
Ads... nothing useful.

keys: Tiene cara de pocos amigos. No lo miro.
en: He doesn't look friendly. I won't look at him.
A kid with a balloon.

keys: Es el único aquí que no tiene prisa.
en: He's the only one here who isn't in a hurry.
Everyone's in their own world...
Better that way.
In a hurry.

keys: Debe saber exactamente a dónde va.
en: Must know exactly where they're headed.

keys: Camina como si tuviera todo el día.
en: Walking like there's all the time in the world.
I could ask... Next time.

keys: Mejor no me alejo más. Si me pierdo más, no sabré volver.
en: I'd better not go any farther. If I get more lost, I won't find my way back.

keys: Ropa de deporte. Sale a correr... por gusto.
en: Workout clothes. Going for a run... for fun.

keys: A mí me cuesta salir hasta para comprar.
en: It's hard for me to go out even to buy groceries.
Studying with people all around.

keys: Yo no podría ni leer una línea.
en: I couldn't read a single line.

keys: Nunca aprendí a conducir. Tampoco tuve a dónde ir.
en: I never learned to drive. I never had anywhere to go, either.

keys: Una mudanza. Alguien empezando de cero... Qué valor.
en: Someone moving. Starting from scratch... That takes guts.

keys: Hay alguien dentro comiéndose un bocadillo. No miro. No miro.
en: Someone's inside eating a sandwich. Not looking. Not looking.

keys: Otra máquina. El dinero ya tiene dueño.
en: Another machine. That money's already spoken for.

keys: Aunque un chocolate no estaría mal...
en: Although a chocolate bar wouldn't hurt...
The same mini-market flyer.

keys: Alguien vive aquí y sabe exactamente cómo volver.
en: Someone lives here and knows exactly how to get back.

keys: Si tocara el timbre, ¿qué diría? "Hola, me perdí"... No.
en: If I rang the bell, what would I say? "Hi, I'm lost"... No.

keys: Hay luz dentro. Alguien está en casa.
en: The lights are on. Someone's home.

keys: Plantas en la ventana. A mí nunca me duran.
en: Plants in the window. Mine never last.

keys: Se oye una tele. Como en mi casa.
en: I can hear a TV. Like at home.

keys: Un portero automático. Odio hablar por esas cosas.
en: An intercom. I hate talking into those things.

keys: Tantos timbres. Tanta gente que no conozco.
en: So many doorbells. So many people I don't know.

keys: Cerrado. Casi me alegro: así no tengo que hablar con nadie.
en: Closed. I'm almost glad: this way I don't have to talk to anyone.

keys: Está leyendo. Mejor no lo interrumpo.
en: He's reading. I'd better not interrupt.

keys: Está mirando discos. Mejor lo dejo tranquilo.
en: He's browsing records. I'll leave him alone.

keys: Solo por el paso de cebra.
en: Only at the crosswalk.

keys: No me gusta romper las reglas.
en: I don't like breaking the rules.

keys: Estas casas se parecen a las de mi barrio.
en: These houses look like the ones in my neighborhood.
...Almost.
This looks like a shopping area...
There must be a store nearby
Walk normally. How do you walk normally?
I've been here before. I think.
In their own world.
Better not bother them.
Didn't even look at me.
Looks like they're in a hurry.
No... better not.
I wouldn't know what to say.
Better not interrupt.
Another day, maybe.
No... not like that.

keys: Afuera, la calle sigue siendo desconocida. Pero Alice sabe hacia dónde ir.
en: Outside, the street is still unfamiliar. But Alice knows which way to go.

keys: Aprieta el ticket con el número de Leo.
en: She holds the receipt with Leo's number tight.
I gave him my number. What did I do?

keys: Siente una mezcla de pánico y algo que no sabe nombrar.
en: She feels a mix of panic and something she can't name.

keys: Pero sonríe. Nadie la ve, pero sonríe.
en: But she smiles. Nobody sees it, but she smiles.

keys: Mira el ticket con el número de Leo.
en: She looks at the receipt with Leo's number.

keys: «No me atreví a darle el mío.»
en: I didn't dare give him mine.

keys: Siente un pequeño peso en el pecho. Pero también que hizo algo que nunca había hecho antes.
en: She feels a small weight on her chest. But also that she did something she had never done before.
Next time.

keys: Guarda el papel con cuidado en la mochila y camina hacia la plaza, como Leo le indicó.
en: She tucks the paper carefully into her backpack and walks toward the plaza, like Leo told her.

keys: Está un poco menos perdida que antes. Pero todavía no está en casa.
en: She's a little less lost than before. But she's not home yet.

keys: Qué edificio más raro... todo de cristal.
en: What a strange building... all glass.

keys: Si le preguntara a alguien, ya habría llegado. ...No.
en: If I asked someone, I'd be there by now. ...No.

keys: Podría fijarme mejor en los carteles. O en lo que dice la gente.
en: I could pay more attention to the signs. Or to what people say.

keys: Un minimercado junto a la torre de cristal... Quizá al otro lado de la avenida.
en: A mini-market next to the glass tower... Maybe across the avenue.

keys: No hace falta alejarme. El metro está aquí, en la plaza.
en: No need to wander off. The metro is right here, in the plaza.

keys: Por ahí vine. Ahora, a buscar el metro.
en: That's where I came from. Now, to find the metro.
Mom...!
(sniff) Mom?
MOM!

keys: ¿Por qué llevas auriculares si no escuchas nada?
en: Why are you wearing headphones if you're not listening to anything?

keys: Tu pelo parece un nido. Me gusta.
en: Your hair looks like a nest. I like it.
Are you scared? I'm a little bit.
Why do you look at the ground when you walk?

keys: El tren todavía no ha pasado.
en: The train hasn't come yet.
Her mom first.

keys: Camina derecho un buen rato, como Leo le indicó. La calle se ensancha, los edificios se abren.
en: She walks straight ahead for a long while, as Leo told her. The street widens, the buildings open up.

keys: Cuando llega a la plaza, el sol ya empieza a bajar.
en: By the time she reaches the plaza, the sun is starting to set.
Do you live alone?

keys: Mi mamá tiene un vestido rosa. ¿Ya te lo dije?
en: My mom has a pink dress. Did I tell you already?
Do you have a mom? Where is she?

keys: Llegué. Solo falta bajar al metro y...
en: I made it. I just have to go down to the metro and...
...Is someone crying?

keys: Alice da la vuelta a la estación cerrada. La noche empieza a caer.
en: Alice walks around the closed station. Night is starting to fall.

keys: Las calles se ven diferentes sin la luz del sol. O tal vez es ella, que las mira con otros ojos.
en: The streets look different without the sunlight. Or maybe it's her, seeing them with different eyes.

keys: Tiene hambre. Tiene frío. No sabe dónde va a dormir.
en: She's hungry. She's cold. She doesn't know where she'll sleep.

keys: Pero algo en su pecho no es miedo. No del todo.
en: But something in her chest isn't fear. Not entirely.

keys: Camina sin rumbo, buscando algún lugar con luz. Y entonces, escucha una voz.
en: She walks aimlessly, looking for somewhere with light. And then she hears a voice.
It isn't crying. It's singing.

keys: Alguien en la plaza tiene que haberla visto.
en: Someone in the plaza must have seen her.

keys: Mejor preguntarle a alguien más, por si acaso.
en: I'd better ask someone else, just in case.

keys: La fuente. Vamos a la fuente.
en: The fountain. Let's go to the fountain.

keys: Lee el periódico de verdad, en papel.
en: He's reading an actual paper newspaper.
So calm. I couldn't do that.

keys: Les habla a las palomas como si fueran sus nietos.
en: She talks to the pigeons like they're her grandkids.
And they actually listen to her.

keys: Toca bien. Nadie se para a escucharlo.
en: He plays well. Nobody stops to listen.
I'm not stopping either... Sorry.

keys: Se ríen de algo. Parece tan fácil.
en: They're laughing about something. It looks so easy.

keys: Hablan como si se conocieran de toda la vida.
en: They talk like they've known each other forever.

keys: Su perrito no le quita los ojos al picnic.
en: Her puppy can't take its eyes off the picnic.

keys: Pasea sin prisa, con las manos en los bolsillos.
en: No rush at all, hands in pockets.

keys: Parece que conoce bien el barrio.
en: Looks like someone who knows the neighborhood.

keys: Va y viene por el paseo.
en: Back and forth along the path.

keys: Igual también está esperando a alguien.
en: Maybe waiting for someone too.
Can I go home?
I gotta go.
Everyone's staring.
I want to leave.
What if I mess up?
Wilson's waiting for me.

keys: No me conviene alejarme. La entrada del metro debería estar por aquí cerca.
en: Better not wander off. The metro entrance should be around here somewhere.

keys: Lee como si el metro no existiera.
en: Reading like the metro doesn't exist.
I wish I had that kind of patience.

keys: Mira la hora cada dos segundos.
en: Checking the time every two seconds.

keys: Él sí sabe a dónde va.
en: At least he knows where he's going.
...Habit.
With my cat.
Me too. A little bit.

keys: ¿Y si mi mamá ya se fue a casa?
en: What if my mom already went home?
...Thanks. I think.
So I don't trip.
Why are you walking so fast?
Sorry.
Look! A pigeon!

keys: Es la quinta que me enseñas.
en: That's the fifth one you've shown me.

keys: ¿Crees que ese señor conocía a mi mamá?
en: Do you think that man knew my mom?

keys: No lo sé. Pero la vio. Algo es algo.
en: I don't know. But he saw her. That's something.

keys: Unas cuantas veces. Rosa. Lo tengo.
en: A few times. Pink. Got it.
Does your cat know any tricks?
He knows how to hide shoes.
If you were an animal, which one would you be?

keys: Un gato. Para dormir todo el día.
en: A cat. So I could sleep all day.

keys: Cuando sea grande voy a tener un perro enorme.
en: When I grow up I'm going to have a huge dog.
Bigger than you?
Is the fountain much farther?
Almost there. Are you tired?

keys: No creo que se haya ido. Todavía nos queda buscarla.
en: I don't think she left. We still have to look for her.
I'm a little bit hungry.
Me too. We'll find something later, okay?

keys: Ya casi no tengo ganas de llorar.
en: I almost don't feel like crying anymore.

keys: Si te vuelven las ganas, no pasa nada.
en: If you feel like it again, that's okay.

keys: ¿Tú te habías perdido antes? Antes de hoy, digo.
en: Had you ever been lost before? Before today, I mean.

keys: Sí. Aunque normalmente me las arreglo sola.
en: Yes. Though usually I manage on my own.
She's alone. Where are her parents?

keys: Alguien la va a ayudar. Alguien que no tenga un tren que coger.
en: Someone will help her. Someone who doesn't have a train to catch.

keys: ...Debería preguntarle qué le pasa. Pero el metro...
en: ...I should ask her what's wrong. But the metro...

keys: Aquí no hay nadie con vestido rosa.
en: There's nobody in a pink dress here.

keys: Vamos, Lía. Por aquí no es.
en: Come on, Lía. It's not this way.

keys: Solo hasta encontrar a su mamá. Después, el metro.
en: Just until we find her mom. Then, the metro.

keys: Tiene el número de Leo y el dibujo de Lía en el bolsillo.
en: She has Leo's number and Lía's drawing in her pocket.
...Strawberry, then.
...No, better not.
...Yes. Very pink.
...We'll see.
Well, she sings a different one. But similar.
Cof... fee.

keys: Cuando encontremos a mi mamá, le pido un helado.
en: When we find my mom, I'll ask her for an ice cream.

keys: Cuando encontremos a mi mamá, podemos hacer un picnic.
en: When we find my mom, we can have a picnic.

keys: Cuando sea mayor voy a poner un anuncio. «Se busca mamá».
en: When I'm big I'm going to put up an ad. "Mom wanted."

keys: Cuando sea mayor voy a tener una igual.
en: When I grow up I'm getting one just like it.
Chocolate.

keys: El señor dijo que luego me da un helado.
en: The man said he'll give me an ice cream later.
Better not. It's not ours.
Better not. We'll keep looking.

keys: Muy bien. Más rápido que yo.
en: Very good. Faster than me.
I don't know.

keys: No lo sé. No mires tanto.
en: I don't know. Don't stare.
I don't see any.
Similar counts too.
It says "coffee".

keys: Si me siento en esa mesa, ¿parezco mayor?
en: If I sit at that table, do I look older?

keys: Si te lo prometió, te lo dará.
en: If he promised, he'll give it to you.
They're ads.
He plays nice.
You're coming too.
A little. Like eight.
And one for you.
I read slowly.

keys: Yo quiero un perro, pero mi mamá dice que la casa es pequeña.
en: I want a dog, but my mom says our house is small.

keys: Yo tengo un gato. Cabe en cualquier sitio.
en: I have a cat. He fits anywhere.
It's pink!
I read it by myself!
My mom sings that one!
An ice-cream van!
A puppy!
A pet shop! Are there puppies?
Are those two boyfriend and girlfriend?
Can I pet it?

keys: ¿Por qué esa columna tiene papeles pegados?
en: Why does that column have papers stuck on it?
Why doesn't anyone give him money?
What does it say there?
Do you have animals?
A red bike!
Can you ride a bike?

keys: Sé caerme. Eso se me da muy bien.
en: I know how to fall off. I'm really good at that.
Pigeons!
Look! That one's fatter!
Come see her. Come on!
Lía...
Wait for me! Bye-bye, fat pigeon!
